Page information Cite this page Get shortened URL Print/export Download as PDF Printable version In other projects Wikidata item Appearance move to sidebar hide From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia Music award ceremony 2017 Billboard Music Awards Date May 21, 2017 ( 2017-05-21 ) Location T-Mobile Arena , Las Vegas , Nevada , United States Hosted by Ludacris Vanessa Hudgens Most wins Drake (13) Most nominations The Chainsmokers and Drake (22 each) Television/radio coverage Network ABC Runtime 130 minutes Viewership 8.70 million ← 2016 · Billboard Music Awards · 2018 → The 2017 Billboard Music Awards ceremony was held at the T-Mobile Arena in Las Vegas , Nevada on May 21, 2017. [ 1 ] The list of nominees was announced on April 10, 2017. [ 2 ] Non-televised awards were announced on Billboard website the same day as the main ceremony.
